author: fwyzard
body: #### PR description: The streamer output modules accept `compression_algorithm` "LZ4", with `compression_level` 1-3 for the fast LZ4 compressor and 4-12 for LZ4 HC (ROOT uses the same split and stops at 9). Since the fast compressor does not take a compression level, the streamer files created for levels 1-3 are identical. Compressed events start with the `L4` header, and the input sources and `DiagStreamerFile` detect and decompress them like the other algorithms. The output tests take a compression level; NewStreamerLZ4 and NewStreamerLZ4HC run the round trip at levels 1 and 9. LZ4 is faster than zstd level 1, but creates significantly larger files. LZ4HC is as slow as zlib and zstd, so it's only useful when the fastest decompression is needed. #### PR validation: Unit tests pass. Streamer files in Lz4 format were read back and used to run an HLT job.
title: Add LZ4 compression to the streamer format
